name: csr-desk
displayName: CSR Desk for Commercial Insurance Agencies
description: An agentic CSR desk any commercial-lines agency can plug in: eleven CSR agents (intake, loss runs, COI/ACORD, markets, client desk, renewals, claims, records, dec pages, exclusions, policy checking) and an AE feedback loop. Routing, stop-limiters, gates and arithmetic are deterministic code; drafts only until the agency turns it live; every irreversible act needs a human. Ships researched NJ/NY/CT rules, Applied Epic/HawkSoft/EZLynx adapters, and a guided per-agency setup.
